description:
HomeSafe Report uncovers the everyday hazards hiding inside your home before they turn into serious problems. From overloaded outlets and dangerous appliances to electrical fire risks and common mistakes most homeowners never think twice about — we explain what can go wrong, why it happens, and the simple steps you can take to make your home safer.

New home safety videos every week. Watch, check your home, and catch the danger before it becomes a disaster.

⚠️ General home-safety education only — not professional electrical advice. If you notice damaged wiring, warm outlets, repeated breaker trips, or anything you're unsure about, contact a licensed electrician.

#HomeSafety #ElectricalSafety #FireSafety #HomeHazards #FirePrevention
